strings: m_c's eyes are rather unique. Even in fairly normal light {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} pupils look reddish.
m_c has always been squinting, complaining about the light. Upon inspection, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes are rather odd.
Ever since m_c opened {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes, r_c0 has been telling old stories of white cats with red eyes.
